ask.text: Should the on/off state be a new mode of the existing ZestButton (the same button that stays pressed when it is on, like a Bold button in an editor), or a separate switch-style control (a sliding track and knob, like a settings switch)?
ask.why: It decides what developers import and what the control looks like: a mode of ZestButton keeps the button's look, sizes, variants and busy/confirm behaviour and adds a pressed look; a separate switch is a new exported component with its own shape and styling.

options.label: A toggle mode on ZestButton
options.consequence: Developers turn it on through the existing zest prop; the button keeps its sizes, variants and themes and clearly looks pressed or not pressed. No new export is needed.

options.label: A separate switch component
options.consequence: A new exported component with a sliding track and knob, designed only for on/off; it does not share the button's busy and confirm behaviour.

options.label: Both
options.consequence: More to build, document and test; the toggle mode ships first and the switch is a second piece of work.

coverage.note: Developers installing the library; the form of the control is the open point.
